patch_description:
This approach removes the high-capacity variational transformation and treats the dataset-provided mean Z-Z correlator as a sufficient quantum feature. Each block contains one fixed CZ gate. Because CZ commutes with every Z-Z readout and the block is repeated six times, the six identical involutions cancel exactly, leaving the prepared state unchanged. Training therefore reduces to a two-parameter affine calibration of the fixed quantum statistic.

This provides strong regularization, eliminates circuit-parameter optimization and barren-plateau risk, reduces the total parameter count from 146 to 2, and lowers the repeated circuit from 186 gates to 6 while preserving the classifier’s relevant observable.
